messages:
Sam: FYI I opened a docs PR to tighten SOC2-friendly wording around audit-log retention and include updated SDK snippets for Go/Node. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4891
DocBot: PR #4891 opened by Sam  draft docs/compliance/audit-log-retention.md
Lina: Quick pass done. Found two issues: the Go snippet still uses `ttl_days` and the Node snippet uses `retentionDays` camelCase; our v2 canonical option is `retention_days` (snake_case) in JS examples and `RetentionDays` in Go.
Sam: Lina can you push the renames? I want the docs and snippets to match SDK reference exactly so snippet tests pass.
Lina: Pushed commit: renamed params and fixed imports. Also added a KMS header example line. Example used in Go snippet:
```go
// export audit logs with configurable retention
err := client.ExportLogs(ctx, ExportOptions{RetentionDays: 90, RedactPII: true})
```
Lina: Note: I intentionally used 90 in examples. We shouldn't state that as a platform default without legal sign-off.
Marta (Legal): Agreed. Legal guidance: avoid asserting a default retention unless it's enforced. Suggest wording: "Example retention window: 90 days (customer configurable). Customers should confirm retention requirements for their compliance regimes." Also avoid phrasing that implies Redwood can access customer content indefinitely  prefer "retention window" or "export window" language.
Harry: Ops ask: add a one-liner differentiating product retention from backups/archives. Many customers conflate these. Proposed sentence: "Retention controls what is returned by exports and visible in the product; backups/archives may persist according to our internal backup policy and are only accessible via legal process."
Kevin (SDK): For the SDK side: I need an acceptance checklist for snippet automation: (1) example compiles, (2) uses public APIs only, (3) matches casing/param names in the SDK reference, (4) add changelog note so docs automation picks up snippet compatibility. Also: is ExportLogs GA in Dedicated?
Lina: ExportLogs is GA in hosted; for Dedicated it's feature-flagged. I'll annotate both snippets with a short note: "Hosted GA; Dedicated may require the Export feature flag."
Sam: Marta, can you propose alternative top-paragraph phrasing to replace "we retain logs for 90 days by default"?
Marta (Legal): Replace with: "Example retention window: 90 days (configurable). Customers are responsible for confirming retention policies required for their compliance obligations. Redwood supports configurable retention and export features; backups and longer-term archives are governed by our internal backup policy and legal processes."
Sam: Good. I'll update the paragraph and re-run the link-check.
DocBot: Lint: docs/compliance/audit-log-retention.md  link-checker verified 14 links; md-lint: 0 warnings
Kevin (SDK): I'll add a short line to SDK CHANGELOG and open a PR to ensure the snippet examples are covered by snippet-tests. Will tag the PR with "docs-snippet" label.
Lina: Updated Node snippet to use snake_case and added small redaction example showing prefix masking. Node example:
```js
// export with retention in Node SDK v2
await client.exportLogs({ retention_days: 90, redact_pii: true })
```
Lina: Also added a tiny note pointing to the redaction guide and the export permissions doc.
Harry: Please also add tenant scoping note: "Exports are scoped to the requesting tenant and require IAM permissions." That avoids confusion in multi-tenant contexts.
Marta (Legal): One more nit: avoid absolutes like "permanent" or "never". Use "longer-term archive" and refer to "legal process" for access.
Sam: Action list: (1) merge Lina's param/name fixes and feature-flag notes; (2) update top paragraph with Marta's phrasing; (3) insert Harry's backup/tenant clarifications; (4) Kevin to add SDK changelog and snippet-test PR. I'll request final infra/legal reviews after commits.
Kevin (SDK): On it. I'll ping CI once changelog PR lands.
Lina: Merged the rename and wording commits, added the feature-flag note and redaction link.
Marta (Legal): Reviewed the updated top paragraph and tenant/backups wording  LGTM.
Harry: LGTM, added ops link to backup policy.
Sam: Merged PR #4891. I'll follow up with a short migration note for Dedicated customers describing the feature-flag and how to request enablement. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
